description: TY2026: S corporation (LLC + valid S election) with C-year accumulated E&P — BOTH entity-level taxes. SS 1375: passive investment income 40,000 > 25% of 100,000 gross receipts -> excess net passive income = 30,000 x (40,000-25,000)/40,000 = 11,250 -> 21% = 2,362.50. SS 1374: built-in gain 10,000 (within the recognition period), capped at as-if-C TI 50,000 -> 21% = 2,100.00. Entity-level total $4,462.50.
